n_intro.text: Meet Receptly: the AI receptionist that never misses a call.

n_problem.text: Busy with a client? Closed for the night? Every unanswered call is a booking you've lost.

n_landing.text: Now Ava answers every call, on your phone line or right from your website. Listen.

c1.text: Thank you for calling Luma Hair Studio, this is Ava. This call may be recorded and transcribed. How can I help you today?

c2.text: Hi! Can I get a haircut with Sara tomorrow afternoon?

c3.text: Sara has 2:30 PM or 4:00 PM tomorrow. Which works best for you?

c5.text: Lovely — a haircut with Sara tomorrow at 2:30 PM, for Ayesha Khan. Shall I book it?

c7.text: You're all set! A confirmation email is on its way. Anything else I can help with?

n_booked.text: It's in Google Calendar instantly, and the confirmation email is already sent.

n_overview.text: Every call, every booking, every result, in one dashboard.

n_detail.text: Open any call for the full transcript, every action Ava took, and an AI summary.

n_teach.text: Teach Ava your prices, hours and FAQs in minutes. No code.

n_trust.text: She only offers times that are really free, never double-books, and hands off to your team whenever a caller asks.

n_mobile.text: Your front desk, in your pocket.

n_outro.text: Receptly. Never miss a call again.
